reviews.title: Would buy again
reviews.comment: Worked as described, wrong color came in but other than that excellent. It fit in the case no issues, doesn't over heat and transfers power the way it's supposed to.
reviews.author: Orlando

reviews.title: Received two consecutive dead units
reviews.comment: I had a very disappointing experience with this product. The first unit I received was dead on arrival (DOA). I performed thorough troubleshooting, using a voltmeter to verify zero output (both with and without a load) and attempting the "paper clip test." After exchanging it through Amazon, the second unit arrived with the exact same failure. I eventually purchased a different brand locally, which worked immediately. Based on receiving two defective units in a row, I cannot recommend this power supply.
reviews.author: John Mayson
